reviewMethod: Individual reading and editorial assessment of each final prompt. Whole-catalogue exact, TF-IDF and LSA candidate retrieval informs semantic adjudication. AI provenance remains separate from human approval.
similarityAdjudication: Individually reviewed all 200 and rewrote 57 abstract or internally repetitive openings into specific relationship situations. Replaced generic feedback question overlapping existing entry. Remaining retrieval matches share wording but differ in meaning: observed resilience versus observed personal change, a childhood holiday to plan together versus passing on a custom, response to public appearance comments versus compliments, shared stewardship versus private pride, and personal name versus music and dance.
